actions.name: curve left in the dark (left wheel 0 %, right wheel 30 %)
curve right in the dark (left wheel 30 %, right wheel 0 %)
drive forward at 30 % in the dark
curve left following the line (left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 %)
curve right following the line (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 %)

control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70, then if line tracker < 40 curve left, else if line tracker > 88 curve right, else do nothing.
avoidWalls, driveInTheDark, stopAtWall and followLine are defined but never called.
avoidWalls: in dim light, turn away from LEFT or RIGHT obstacles, else call driveInTheDark; in bright light call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 drive forward, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle stop, else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left, else curve right.

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow the black line when it is under the robot and drive straight where there is none; in the light, follow the line as before.
